main_text.l: וַיָּמָת & mortuus est, שָׁמְתוּ quod morientur, יָמֻתוּן morientur, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. præf. R. מות.
וַיָּמֵת & occidit, וַיְמִיתֵם eos, וַיְמִיתֵהוּ eum, וַיָּמִיתוּ & occiderunt eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. מות.
וַיְמִתְּהוּ et interfecit eum, fut. Piel, vel Poel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מות.
יִנָּאֵן efflorescet, Eccl. 12. 5. pro יִנִּין, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נין.
יִנָּאֲצוּ contemnent, fut. Kal, יִנְאֲצֵנִי me, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. R. נאץ.
יִנָּבֵא prophetabit, וַיִּנָּבְאוּ & prophetârunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. & pl. Rad. נבא.
וַיִּנָּגְשׁוּ & tacti sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. נגע.
יִנָּגַּף percutietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נגף.
יְנַהֲדוּ expellent eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. aff. Rad. נדד.
וַיָּנֻדוּ & vagati sunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. נוד.
וַיִּנָּהוּ & lamentati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. נהה.
יִנּוֹבַב progerminabit, fut. Piel, seu Poel, R. נוב.
יִנּוֹן propagabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m, à Rad. No. נין filius.
יִנּוֹעַ movebitur, יִנּוֹעוּ movebuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. נוע.
יִנָּזֵר abstrahetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נזר.
וַיָּנַח & quievit, (pro יָנוּחַ,) fut. Kal, 3. f. s. m. R. נוח.
וַיַּנַּח & collocavit, fut. Hiph. (יַנִּיחַ,) 3. f. s. m. Rad. נוח.
וַיַּנִּיחוּ & collocaverunt eos, וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ eum, fut. Hiph.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are only partly legible at this scan resolution, so Hebrew forms with vowel points are approximate and not checked letter by letter. Doubtful Hebrew readings: the first Hebrew form on the second line of the first entry (שָׁמְתוּ), the third line form (יָמֻתוּן), the form for "abstrahetur" (נזר), and the Hebrew in "percutietur" and "expellent eum", where the printed letters overlap. The bare letter נ is printed centred as a section marker. The left and right column headers show only letter marks, which were not transcribed as a running head. The page has no catchword or signature.
